name: Validate Drug Extraction
plugin_description: Sync medications, pharmacies, and providers from call transcripts to Contact records
action_description: Validates each medication entry in an extracted medications JSON string for required fields, types, and enum values

inputs.name: extracted_medications_json
inputs.label: Extracted Medications JSON
inputs.description: JSON array string of medication objects to validate, each with status, name, form, dosage, etc.

outputs.name: invalid_json
outputs.label: Invalid JSON
outputs.description: True if the input failed validation, false if it passed
